svg.title: CompBench pipeline overview
svg.desc: Four rounded base frames arranged left to right. Frame f01 contains source data collection: a filmstrip of video/mask frames, a clapper-board dataset icon with label, and a quality-assessment filtering icon with label. Frame f02 contains mask preprocessing: a black multi-object mask-splitting preview with colored animal masks and label, a second black strip with colored masks and pass/fail markers, plus a robot icon and occlusion/continuity label. Frame f03 contains task-specific pipeline: object edit operation list, implicit task graph with multi-turn/multi-object and action-location-viewpoint annotations, and post-filtering report icon. Frame f04 contains CompBench: paired example scene previews, task instruction text, and bottom task-list to lightbulb relation with 9 tasks and 3k+ edits. Symmetry basis: the whole figure is horizontally sequenced with equal vertical centering of frames and arrows; inside each panel elements are arranged top-to-bottom around local horizontal center lines.
